last_done_increment.summary: 2026-07-11: the JSON-LD advertised a retired $19/$49 tier while the checkout charged $39/$99/$249. That is the price Google quotes to a buyer before they ever reach the site, so the first thing we told them about ourselves was wrong by half. Root cause: the numbers were copied into four places (landing, billing, paywall, JSON-LD) and only the invisible copy drifted, because it is the one nobody looks at. Fix: the commercial facts (price, monthly quota, Polar checkout envKey) now live only in app/lib/plans.ts and all four surfaces derive from it — the same pattern app/lib/founder.ts already uses to feed both the founder card and its schema. Copy stays per-surface; only the facts are shared. The contact tier emits no Offer rather than a placeholder price (an Offer without a price earns no rich result, and inventing one would misquote the checkout in the other direction). 7 new unit tests fail if a retired price ever resurfaces. Verified against the rendered page, not just the tests: GET /en emits offers at 39/99/249 with zero occurrences of $19/$49, and all four visible cards still render price, quota and CTA. Green: tsc, eslint (0 errors), npm test 19/19, next build. Prior increments this branch: GLO-EN-TRUSTANCHOR (7abe07a), GLO-EN-PAYHIST (406b411), GLO-HARDEN (a1e8f62).
